children: Saudi-listed Edarat Communication and Information Technology Co (Edarat) will deploy a total of SAR 127.54 million ($34.01 million) to boost its computing infrastructure amid high demand for artificial intelligence and cloud computing.

The technology firm, which specialises in data centre engineering, cloud hosting and IT infrastructure management services, said on Wednesday that it has issued a purchase order to acquire new cloud infrastructure and GPU computing equipment from Aklaniat Technologies.
The new investment will be funded through a combination of local bank credit facilities and vendor financing.
The company expects to receive the equipment in five phases over the next six months.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Saudi-listed Edarat deploys $34mln to boost computing infrastructure
